high_level_description: This image is a sponsored post from the Instagram account "stir_world." The post features an advertisement for the Ohmie Lamp by Krill Design. The text reads: "Ohmie Lamp by Krill Design is the world's first 3D printed lamp made of orange peels. Read more on STIRworld.com." The image shows a unique lamp with a cylindrical shade that appears to be made of a material resembling orange peel. The base of the lamp has a wavy, organic shape, which adds to its distinctive design. Next to the lamp, there is a whole orange placed for scale, emphasizing the lamp's size relative
